Quest Location:
Yokai Pirate
Quests Begun From:
Empress Ai No Miko
Note:
These quests can only be completed
once
.
Wokou
Shanty Sha-N-Ti
Highly Buoyant Metal Armor
Salty Roots
We have safely departed from port and the crew hoisted our black flags. Take this time to acquaint yourself with the ship and the people aboard it.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
In the Yokai Isles, pirates are known as Wokou, but were unheard of while Kitsune was alive. Though we have our freedom because of you, Wokou have taken advantage of it and are becoming active again. Ah, no times are ever truly peaceful so we may only do our best.
Items Required:
Explore Ship x1
Go to Screen 4
Take to Yue x1
Talk to
Yue Huang
Talk to Baoyu x1
Talk to
Baoyu Lin
Rewards:
0 Gold
5,000 Exp
Thanks to Anonymous Joe.
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The disguised pirates on board this ship are warriors from Yokai, and they'd like you to show them how real pirates act. Treat them to a sword fight, and a song or two. I heard that such a thing is called a shanty.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Yo ho, yo ho! It really does keep the morale high. Yue is below deck in the living quarters with some of the other descendants. I wonder why she isn't up here joining in on the shanties. Would you mind going to check on her?
Items Required:
Pirate Shantied x8
Dropped by
Disguised Pirate
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
18,000 Exp
Thanks to Anonymous Joe.
Requirements:
Must have completed the '
Horizon's Green Flash
' quest.
The crew of a pursuing Greenguard warship has boarded, but they're knights? They aren't firing their canons on us either. Capture them and make them tell us who they serve.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The knights serve the Lord of the Neverglades and are demanding that we release our prisoners. Queen Victoria promised our ship safe passage which means one of her nobles is acting out of line or they're colluding with the emissaries from Wuji.
Items Required:
Knight Captured x8
Dropped by
Neverglades Knight
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
18,000 Exp
Thanks to Anonymous Joe.
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
We were close to making a clean escape, but a Lord from Greenguard's Neverglades has intercepted us. He's waiting on the island's shore and won't back down unless you defeat him in a duel. Please Hurry, he may have already alerted our location to the Wuji Emissaries.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I am confident we will succeed, and if we can push them just a little farther…then I'll be able to see if there is any pride to be had for my Wuji lineage. Lord Brentan met with their Naval Admiral; a warrior who has held their rank for centuries. Admiral Shen "The Radiant Mirage" Zheng.
Items Required:
Neverglades Lord Dueled x1
Dropped by
Lord Brentan (Monster) (Level 41)
Rewards:
4,000 Gold
36,000 Exp
Thanks to Anonymous Joe.

Kabuki Rehearsal
We may be surrounded, but I believe that our ruse can still turn the Wuji Emissaries back. Read over my script and have Lord Brentan, his knights, and our pirates act out the fights with you.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I understand genuinely believing that we were pirates. That was the point of our plan after all, but he disobeyed Queen Victoria's orders to stay out of Yokai's waters. This will cause a great deal of trouble.
Items Required:
Gold Leaf Brooch x1 (Stacks up to 5)
Dropped by
Lord Brentan (Monster) (Level 41)
Knight's Emblem x7 (Stacks up to 35)
Dropped by
Neverglades Knight
Yokai Pirate's Piece x7 (Stacks up to 35)
Dropped by
Disguised Pirate

4,500 Exp

x1

Quest Location:
Nova Shrine
Quests Begun From:
Empress Ai No Miko
Byakko
Suzaku
Genbu
Seiryu
Hoshiyoru
This Empyrean Dragon is made of four constellations, one of them being Byakko, the White Tiger of the West. If you bring me tiger fur from the beasts in /fireforge, I can create and bless an amulet for you to bring into the duel. The stars would be conflicted about attacking their own visage.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Byakko also represents the season of Autumn, and the orange fur of the tigers invokes the imagery of falling leaves. I believed the stars of Byakko would be proud, but they decided to merge with the Empyrean Dragon. They must want the title of "Dragon of Space" quite badly.
Items Required:
Tiger Fur x20
Dropped by:
Armored Tiger
Firestorm Tiger (Version 3)
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
1,500 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The second constellation is Suzaku, the Vermillion Bird of the South. There are many powerful firebirds in Lore, but we'll keep it easy. Travel to the /DreamPalace. I heard from Pharaoh Zhoom that there are Flaming Harpies there to gather feathers from.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Suzaku represents Fire and Summer, as well as the South. The names of the seven stars in its constellation are, hmm, let me try to remember…Nuriko, Tamahome, Hotohori, Mitsukake, Chichiri, Tasuki, and Chiriko. They, and the twenty- one other stars in that Dragon, seem to have lofty goals.
Items Required:
Harpy Feather x50
Dropped by
Flaming Harpy (Level 45)
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
1,500 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The third constellation is Genbu, the Black Tortoise of the North. They're seen in the sky, intertwined with a snake in an eternal struggle. In that case, bring me Quicksilver scales from /Yokai Treasure, and Nagami scales from /HakuVillage.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The tortoise and snake could be fighting, or hibernating during the Winter. It depends on how you see those stars. Their names are, ah, give me a moment to recall…Uruki, Inami, Tomite, Hatsui, Umiyame, and Hitsuki. I wonder if we'll ever meet one of them individually.
Items Required:
Silver Scales x15
Dropped by
Quicksilver
Nagami Scales x15
Dropped by
Nagami (Level 43)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
1,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The last constellation is Seiryu, the Azure Dragon of the East. The remnants of the Dragons that invaded us are in /HakuWar. Bring me the fangs of the Zmey Warriors and their leader, Zakhvatchik. With those, the spell I'll cast to aid in your victory will be complete.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Seiryu also represents the season of Spring, but its Draconic visage has granted them more power and influence than the others. Oh, you want to know the names of its stars too? My increased studies have jumbled my memory, but their Wuji names are Jiao, Kang, Di, Fang, Xin, Wei, and Ji.
Items Required:
Zmey Fang x15
Dropped by
Zmey Warrior
Zakhvatchik Fang x1
Dropped by
Zakhvatchik
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
2,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Everything has been prepared. The Empyrean Dragon, a fusion of four divine constellations, waits for your answer to their challenge. Defeat them, scatter their stars, and return them to the night sky. Its final fate will ripple across the universe.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Congratulations! I knew you would be victorious. The Nova Empyrean has accepted its loss and will separate back into the four constellations. What would have happened if they won? Do you actually have the power to name them the "Dragon of Space?" Dearest friend, you have many secrets.
Items Required:
Planetary Halo x1 (Stacks up to 10)
Dropped by
Nova Empyrean
Rewards:
2,500 Gold
5,000 Exp
Items:
Cosmic Stardust
x1

Note:

Asterism's Toll
The Stars suffered their first ever sense of defeat at your hands, and have returned as an Astral Empyrean to reissue their challenge. This won't be anything like the last duel. Prepare yourself, and make the Stars fall!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Congratulations on your second victory over the Twenty-Eight Mansions. I believe I will have to give up on opening an observatory here. The Empyrean seems to find these fights to be enjoyable, and will crush anything we build when they have the urge to see you again.
Items Required:
Astral's Supernova x1
Dropped by
Astral Empyrean
Rewards:
350,000 Gold
1,000,000 Exp
Items:
Star of the Empyrean
x1

Quest Location:
Yokai Hunt
Quests Begun From:
Empress Ai No Miko
Requirements:
Must have completed the '
Baihong Guan Ri
' quest.
Xionghuang Remedy
Calabash Elixir
Duàn Qiáo
Sangharama's Blessing
Lady Suzhen
Before you and Lady Suzhen spar, would you help me prepare another wedding gift for her? A Xionghuang Remedy is a universal cure that wards off evil and poison. I can make a jar of it if you gather ingredients from /YokaiRiver for me.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Children aren't allowed to drink the remedy, so we have them wear it in amulets. The drink is special to Lady Suzhen. While she was still a garden snake, her fiance tried to share Xionghuang with her, and panicked when she got lost in the jar.
Items Required:
Funa-Yurei Powder x8 (Stacks up to 40)
Dropped by
Funa-yurei (Level 21)
Kappa Spirits x8 (Stacks up to 40)
Dropped by
Kappa Ninja (1) (Level 21)
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
3,000 Exp
500 Rep :
Yokai
You will receive one of the following items:
Miko's Blessing
x2
Miko's Blessing
x3
Miko's Blessing
x5
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
It's the year of the Wood Snake, and those born during Water years tend to harmonize well with them. With that in mind, bring me some of the Elixir Etokoun's waters. I want to use it to fill a calabash gourd.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
This is another gift for Lady Suzhen's wedding. In her new form, her fangs drip a deadly venom. That hasn't stopped her fiance from trying to kiss her. As long as he has this gourd with him, the cure will always be within reach.
Items Required:
Xiandan Elixir x1 (Stacks up to 5)
Dropped by
Elixir Etokoun
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
4,000 Exp
500 Rep :
Yokai
Items:
Miko's Blessing
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
This is the bridge where Lady Suzhen and her fiance first met. Ever since their story got out, Yokai from all over flocked to find their own human match. The Oni from /HakuVillage have been especially rowdy. May I ask you to get them to behave?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Duan Qiao means 'Broken Bridge', but this one won't collapse. During the winter, half of the bridge is covered by snow while the rest is melted by the sun. This gives it the illusion of being broken, and now it has a reputation for romance as well.
Items Required:
Oni's Charm x14 (Stacks up to 70)
Dropped by
Mountain Oni (Version 1)
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
3,000 Exp
500 Rep :
Yokai
Items:
Miko's Blessing
x3
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Lady Suzhen's deeds have earned her blessings from the Sangharama - powerful spiritual guardians of temples built by Wuji descendants like myself. In thanks, I would ask for your aid in defeating Shadow Samurai from /ShogunWar in their name.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The masks the Shadow Samurai wore are an affront to the Sangharama because they were forged to mimic their faces. Offering the Menpo and breaking them to pieces on the steps of the temples will assert that we only honor true warriors.
Items Required:
Shadow Menpo x21 (Stacks up to 105)
Dropped by
Shadow Samurai (Monster) (Level 20) (Version 1)
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
6,000 Exp
500 Rep :
Yokai
Items:
Miko's Blessing
x6
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
I have a favor to ask of you on the first day of my Zodiac year. Transforming from a humble garden snake to a Guardian Spirit with pearlescent scales is quite the change. A spar with the Zhenzhu Shé, Lady Suzhen's new form, will help get her used to this body. I can't think of a better warrior for this task.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Beautiful! The way the shine of her scales danced with the spark of your blades was as vibrant as a rain of fireworks. Thank you for helping us celebrate the Lunar New Year. I hope we'll get to see you at Lady Suzhen's wedding.
Items Required:
Snake's Pearl x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
Zhenzhu Shé
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
1,000 Rep :
Yokai
Items:
Pearlescent Scale
x1

Quest Location:
Victor Matsuri
Quests Begun From:
Empress Ai No Miko
In Kuzunoha's Image
NeOni Blue
Embodiment of Scarlet
Onihitokuchi
Tsukihime
Kanmu Heishi
The first challenger is a Kitsune named Himawari. Beyond Yue's stall, take the eastern path to begin her test. She aims to challenge the Shrine of the Midnight Sun. Let's see if she's ready for it.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You defeated the Kitsune so soundly that one of her tails dropped off. The foxes tend to sneak their way into noble court with disguises, but the idea of the original Yokai Spirit being one of her kind must have inflated her confidence. Even the long-lived must continue to learn humility.
Items Required:
Sunny Fox Tail x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
Kitsune Himawari
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
3,000 Exp
You may also receive, at random:
Crimson Silk
x1
Midnight Silk
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The second challenger appears to be a Yokai enthusiast dressed as a futuristic Oni. I admire the workmanship, but he may not be taking the matter very seriously. Test him in a duel, and gently let him down.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Real Oni wouldn't sit around and wait for a duel. They'd have flipped ten stalls and started a fire by now. These days, the Oni clans are a lot less wild, but only because their prey - humankind - grew strong enough to be their equals.
Items Required:
NeOni Prop Horn x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
NeOni
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
3,000 Exp
You may also receive, at random:
Crimson Silk
x1
Midnight Silk
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The final challenger is a Vampire from Darkovia, a forest of eternal night. If Narcis Arrhythmia - odd name - were to win the blessing of the Solstice Moon, he would be invincible when the moon rises at noon. Let's make sure this doesn't happen…
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The Vampire has accepted defeat with grace, but I doubt Queen Safiria's court would give up so easily. Hmm, I make it sound more dire than it actually is. We consider Vampires to be Yokai hailing from afar. It won't be difficult to learn how to handle them.
Items Required:
Bloodsoaked Omamori x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
Narcis Arrhythmia (Monster)
Rewards:
1,000 Gold
3,000 Exp
You may also receive, at random:
Crimson Silk
x1
Midnight Silk
x1
Jade Silk
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Are you ready to duel the victors? Take the western path past Yue's stall, and Haruki will be waiting for you. My cousin triumphed over the Shrine and Temple's challenges, but will he be able to hold his own against a true Dragon?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Haruki's unruly, but sturdy. Sometimes he forgets that others aren't so durable. Not having to hold back against you must be freeing to him. Maybe one day, he won't feel the need to cut his Oni horns off.
Items Required:
Broken Oni Horn x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
Haruki Matsuoka (Monster)
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Items:
Crimson Silk
x1
You may also receive, at random:
Midnight Silk
x1
Jade Silk
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The second victor is a noblewoman from Greenguard. Lady Laidronette's family protects the people in and around Darkovia from those who lurk in the night. It'll be interesting to see how you'll duel a descendant of the Solstice Moon himself.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Lady Laidronette faced a much harsher challenge from Sir Arche because of their shared blood. Intriguingly, Priestess Himiko was softer on her. The tides of blood have such a strong pull on the sun and moon.
Items Required:
Sunrise Amulet x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
Lady Laidronette
Rewards:
2,500 Gold
6,000 Exp
Items:
Midnight Silk
x1
You may also receive, at random:
Crimson Silk
x1
Jade Silk
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The final victor is the only one who was able to conquer the Eclipse Ascent by himself. I don't recognize his name, so he may be a ronin…but he dresses like the original Ayakashi Slayer. The duel you'll have will be the peak of our festivities.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Congratulations on your victory! Masakado performed admirably and honorably as well. I doubt I'll find any warrior that can match his bladework in my noble court. He's worth keeping an eye on. But…his helmet doesn't fit. I wonder why he hasn't fixed it.
Items Required:
Agehachou Crest x1 (Stacks up to 100)
Dropped by
Masakado (Monster)
Rewards:
3,000 Gold
10,000 Exp
Items:
Crimson Silk
x1
Midnight Silk
x1
Jade Silk
x1

Quest Location:
Shizaistrath
Quests Begun From:
Empress Ai No Miko
Taotie
Of the Four Perils sent to assassinate me, the Taotie was born from the greed and gluttony of a noble court left unchecked. Their indulgence at the suffering of others created this creature, and it will corrupt the Yokai Realm if we don't destroy it.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
I was born lucky to never know what it's like to be too poor to feed myself. Hunger is only a minor inconvenience to the Isles' nobles. Reveling in this, and believing that indulgence is our right, would birth a Taotie of our own…
Items Required:
Da He Ding Vessel x1 (Stacks up to 300)
Dropped by
Taotie
Rewards:
6,000 Gold
10,000 Exp
Items:
Taotie Emblem
x1
